| Category = Meat recipes

}}

{{recipe}}

==Ingredients==
*4 hot dog buns 
*4 [[Cookbook:Hot Dog|hot dogs]]
*12 slices [[Cookbook:Mozzarella Cheese|mozzarella cheese]]
*1 jar pizza sauce 
*[[Cookbook:Grating|Grated]] [[Cookbook:Parmesan Cheese|Parmesan cheese]]

==Procedure==
# Split hot dogs and hot dog buns lengthwise. 
# Place buns on a [[Cookbook:Baking Sheet|cookie sheet]]. 
# Sprinkle mozzarella cheese over buns. 
# Place split hot dog on each bun. 
# Spread pizza sauce over the hotdogs, sprinkle with Parmesan cheese, and [[Cookbook:Broiling|broil]] until cheese bubbles and the hot dogs are hot.
